scope: No macro-budget optimality claim; ties and solver status can vary.

search_domain.lp: Unbounded real vertex potentials with absolute-residual epigraph; rounded integer primal/dual checked exactly. The certificate, not a finite enumeration, proves the global class floor.
search_domain.budget_milp: 56 integer nonboundary potentials in [-37,37], 92 absolute residues in [0,23], 92 binary nonzero flags; sum(residues)+nonunit-addition flags <=23; at most four nonnegative wire-scale macros plus the two retained negative-scale intervals.
search_domain.stopping_rule: One LP followed by one MILP with time_limit=20 seconds. No seeded restart or random traversal.
search_domain.coverage: Both models completed with a checked feasible witness; no exhaustive grid enumeration and no independently certified macro-budget optimum.
search_domain.preliminary_experiment: Before the budget pivot, one additional 20-second-bounded MILP minimized macro count at the 67-primitive cost. Its reported ten scale macros motivated the explicit 34-macro budget; that solver report is not a published optimality claim.

result: Published 34-macro witness costs 77. Canonical gauge construction may commute unrelated scales; the shipped recipe preserves their original positions. Exact 67-primitive optimum retained as an accounting control.
